SPHENIC NUMBERS WITH INTEGRAL RECIPROCAL SUM -- ALL EXAMPLES OBTAINED SO FAR
==============================================================================
Each example is a set T of sphenic numbers p*q*r (p<q<r primes) with
    sum_{n in T} 1/n = 1   EXACTLY
(an integral sum over <= 73081 terms is necessarily 1, because H_73081 = 1.5557... < 2).
Every example below was (re)generated by sphenic_search.py and verified by verify_sphenic.py
with exact integer / rational arithmetic only (Fraction sum == 1, every element is a product
of exactly 3 distinct primes, p-adic criterion at every prime). No floating point anywhere.
